**Job Title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer \- Lead** 




**Location: Remote** 




**Work Type: Full Time** 




  





**Job Description:**




 As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) for our Data and AI business, you will operate at the front lines of the AI revolution, and act as an elite technical bridge between our core research breakthroughs and our most strategic customers. Unlike traditional software engineers, you are embedded directly within client environments to solve their hardest, highest\-stakes problems by building and shipping production\-grade Agentic AI systems. You operate with the autonomy of a founder, and the technical rigor of a staff engineer to turn messy, real\-world data into measurable business value.
 



 This is a Senior IC role with leadership scope. You will own the entire lifecycle of AI deployment—from initial discovery and scoping to the development of full\-stack systems and guiding the path to client integration. Your success is measured not just by the code you write, but by the client adoption and the workflow impact realized by the client. A pattern you build for one customer becomes an abstraction for many more.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**AI Deployment \& Production Engineering** 



* Lead the client technical engagement and the POD delivering it: Executive communication, reference architectures, alongside building POCs with teammates.
* Drive prototype to production system buildout through tight iteration and feedback cycles, ensure constant learning from evals and demos.
* Collaborate with the larger engineering team to build AI capabilities in the enterprise context.
* Optimize AI workflows for performance, low latency, and reliability under real\-client constraints.
* Harden systems for security and compliance, ensuring models operate safely within regulated environments.
* Utilize advanced AI coding assistants or agentic development tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, regularly to meet client needs.



**Embedded Problem\-Solving \& Feedback** 



* Embed deeply with customer engineering teams to translate open\-ended business challenges (e.g., "reduce fraud") into concrete technical solutions.
* Act as the primary technical owner, troubleshooting complex production issues and serving as the last line of defense in the field.
* Use feedback from the field: failure modes, eval results, latency profiles, and adoption patterns to drive roadmap inputs for the R\&D teams.
* Codify successful field patterns into reusable tools and abstractions; actively contribute to the AI foundational platform within Altimetrik.



**Who You Are** 



* A hands\-on builder with a "radical ownership" mindset—you don't file tickets; you fix problems across the full stack.
* Comfortable with C\-level dialogue and capable of translating complex AI systems into business language for non\-technical executives.
* Industry veteran: 15\+ years of hands\-on AI / Data / Software engineering experience
* Highly proficient in Python, SQL, and modern orchestration frameworks
* Fluent in production work across at least one of the major LLM platforms: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini or AWS Bedrock
* You’ve built agentic workflows, RAG systems, and custom data pipelines within an enterprise environment.
* Have shipped production systems on at least public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), navigated IAM, Data Services, Security and Network controls.
* Able to travel up to 30% of your time. Sustained on\-site interaction is a key differentiator for the FDE role.



**Preferred / Nice to have** 



* Hands\-on experience building applications within a modern data platform: e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery.
* Prior experience building production AI or data systems in a regulated vertical: BFSI, Payments, FinTech, or Life Sciences. Hands\-on familiarity with relevant risk, compliance, and audit frameworks.
* Published writing or open\-source contributions in the agentic AI or data engineering space.

Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI\-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real\-time behavioral insights.
   

  

 Recognized as the \#1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70\+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.
   

  

 With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups, Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces, and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Segment Personalization team is the foundation of Attentive's personalization capabilities, processing and serving data for over 100 million customers daily to enable AI\-driven, personalized customer experiences. We operate mission\-critical infrastructure that powers product recommendations, audience segmentation, and personalized content across the platform. Our systems handle billions of events, serve millions of API requests daily, and drive direct impact to our customer's revenue generation on Attentive.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer II, you will build and improve features across our personalization services, contributing directly to systems that power how Attentive understands products and customers. You will develop a strong understanding of the services you own. Working alongside senior engineers, you will grow your expertise in distributed systems, data pipelines, and real\-time processing.
   

  

 Engineering is changing fast, and this team is pushing the boundaries at our discipline. We believe the craft is moving one level of abstraction higher, away from writing code line by line and toward designing systems with judgment, clarity, and simplicity. We use AI aggressively in how we build, and we expect engineers to think deeply about how our systems work to steer outcomes. If you're ambitious about where engineering is headed, this is a team where you'll develop that mindset by doing real work at scale.
   

  

**What You’ll Accomplish**
* Build and improve the systems that power how Attentive personalizes messages for 100M\+ customers. Your work directly enables our mission of providing bespoke, 1:1 shopping journeys for every customer
* Own features end\-to\-end across our product catalog, customer segmentation, and data ingestion systems, developing a deep understanding of how data flows through our platform and why each piece matters
* Use AI tools to move fast and focus your energy on the harder problems: understanding system behavior, simplifying architecture, and making good design tradeoffs


**Your Expertise**
* 2\-4 years experience as a Software Engineer, with a foundation in building backend services and a desire to deepen your skills in distributed systems
* You understand what clean, correct code looks like and follow established best practices, with a strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals
* You are familiar with relational and non\-relational databases and understand how data modeling and access patterns affect system performance and reliability
* You take ownership beyond the task. You care about the end to end impact of your work, from its operations to its impact on the customer.


**What We Use**
* Our backend is Java / Kotlin / Spring Boot microservices, built with Gradle, coupled with things like DynamoDB, Aurora, AirFlow, Postgres, and Redis, hosted via AWS
* Our infrastructure runs primarily in Kubernetes hosted in AWS’s EKS, using tooling like Istio, Datadog, Terraform, CloudFlare, and Helm
* Our frontend is built with React and TypeScript, and uses best practices like GraphQL, Storybook, Radix UI, Vite, esbuild, and Playwright
* Our automation is driven by custom and open source machine learning models, industry\-leading LLMs, lots of data and tech like Python, Metaflow, HuggingFace, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Pandas


 You'll get competitive perks and benefits, from health \& wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.
   

  

**For US Based Applicants**
* The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $150,000 \- $190,000 annually \+ equity \+ benefits
* Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location

+ Cloud computing and storage systems
+ Infrastructure and large\-scale system design
+ Security
+ Networking and data storage
+ Machine learning and natural language processing tools

* Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.

* Experience working with distributed systems


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with Java, C\+\+, and/or Python
* Experience with NoSQL solutions, Memcache/Redis, Kubernetes, or Google/AWS services
